scope: Pure tests of the exact helper extracted from verify-browser.cjs; no browser or product behavior executed
change: Only numeric negative zero becomes positive zero in expected export data; keys, array order, undefined and nonfinite values stay available for strict comparison

checks.name: Numeric negative zero at every nested position matches its JSON value
Comparison leaves the authoritative source object untouched
Ordinary values, all keys, and array ordering remain exact
A genuine angle difference is rejected
A changed target revision is rejected
A changed task token is rejected
Undefined object keys are preserved and cannot be silently dropped
Undefined array entries cannot silently become JSON null
NaN and both infinities are retained and rejected against JSON null
Sparse array holes are preserved and differ from JSON null entries
Object descriptors and symbol keys survive the zero-only comparison copy
Both real UI export comparison sites use the same zero-only helper

browserAcceptance: Not assessed by this pure regression test; a fresh unchanged-gate full browser suite is still required
